# 0xTsoa

> Open-source, zero-database community registry of reproducible Linux desktop configurations (dotfiles, themes, window manager setups for Wayland and X11), each with verified install scripts, screenshots and community sign-off.

0xTsoa is a static website (Astro, deployed on Vercel at https://0xtsoa.vercel.app). There is no backend and no database: every configuration is a typed JSON file in the GitHub repository (`configs/<author>/<slug>.json`), validated against a JSON Schema in CI and compiled into static pages at build time.

Key facts:

- Each configuration describes a desktop setup: compositor/window manager (Hyprland, Niri, Sway, BSPWM, i3, AwesomeWM...), supported distributions, components, idle RAM footprint, style tags, screenshots and a one-click install command.
- External install scripts are pinned with SHA-256 checksums and pinned Git commits; screenshots are restricted to a whitelist of image hosts.
- Community approval = 👍 ❤️ 🎉 reactions on one GitHub "vote" issue per configuration, snapshotted at build time.
- Submissions arrive through a GitHub Issue Form; a GitHub Actions bot converts the issue into a config JSON and opens a pull request.
- Stack: Astro (static output), Tailwind CSS v4, Zod + JSON Schema, Pagefind (client-side search), Marked + sanitize-html, GitHub Actions.
- Licenses: platform code MIT; registry data (`configs/`) CC BY 4.0; each dotfiles project keeps its upstream license.

## Pages

- [Home](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/): spotlight showcase and search
- [Catalogue](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/catalogue/): every configuration, filterable by compositor, distribution and style
- [Contribute](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/contribute/): how to submit a configuration
- Configuration detail pages: `https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/configs/<author>/<slug>/` (architecture spec, install protocol, rendered upstream README)

## Machine-readable data

- [index.json](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/index.json): full registry as a JSON array (one object per configuration)
- [Sitemap](https://0xtsoa.vercel.app/sitemap-index.xml): every indexable URL
